text: マジん　なっちゃって　ダセーん　だよ！

structure.jp: マジん　なっちゃって

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: マジん　なっちゃって
patterns.explanation: に なる after a word means 'become that'. Here に is slurred to ん in rough speech. マジん なっちゃって = 'getting all serious'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう says the thing went and happened, often in a way the speaker looks down on; ちゃう is its casual short form. なっちゃって = 'going and getting (serious)'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ (short for のだ) gives the feeling of insisting on a fact. ダセー is rough ダサい, so ダセーん だ = 'it's lame, I'm telling you'.
